caption: The drawing depicts a human figure dressed in a long, black, hooded robe sitting on a wooden cart. The figure is holding a drawn bow with an arrow aimed forward. The cart is made of light brown wood, featuring a box-like compartment with vertical and horizontal wooden planks and an elevated wooden seat with a backrest. The cart is supported by a single large wooden wheel on one side and a long handle or shaft extending backward from the side. There is a subtle purple shadow on the ground beneath the cart, indicating the direction of light. The background is plain and off-white with no additional objects present. The signature “MAJEL G. CLOPTIN. TAOS, N.M.” is written in the lower right corner.
title: El Muerto Death Figure and Cart
